column1: # The catalogue of the Auralis modules, as the host needs it.
# One line per module, the fields separated by a tab:
#   code, class id, display name, declared latency, latency tolerance
# The declared latency is the delay the module puts into the signal, in
# samples of the module's own output at 48 kHz.  The tolerance is how far
# the measured delay may be from the declared one, in samples.
# Generated by qa/vst3host/make_catalogue.py.  Do not edit by hand.
